'''Jatix's Herblore Shop''' is a shop in [[Taverley]] owned by [[Jatix]] that sells [[Herblore]] supplies. This shop sells empty [[vial]]s and [[eye of newt|eyes of newt]] in packs.

[[Sanfew]], who plays a part in various quests, is upstairs on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}.
